title: Tank equalizing valve
description: an internal valve used for rapid equalization of tank pressure and downstream line pressure, which can be operated manually, by air, or by cable, and incorporates various valve mechanisms
reference_excerpt: The internal valve in question is classified under heading 8481 of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which covers taps, cocks, valves, and similar appliances. The classification process follows the General Rules of Interpretation (GRI), specifically GRI 1, which states that classification is determined by the terms of the headings and any relevant section or chapter notes. The internal valve does not fit the specific criteria for safety or relief valves outlined in subheading 8481.40.0000, as the essential character of the valve is not primarily safety-related but rather focused on its function of rapid pressure equalization. Therefore, GRI 3(b) cannot be applied.
